transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because my mind just feels... foggy lately. I work at the library, and recently I can't even keep my place in my old cataloguing notes. It's like I just lose track of what I'm looking at. And then I sit there and I can't even decide what simple thing to do next. It's just been very hard to think straight.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?

Yes, I have. Most days lately, I just sit at the kitchen table and... well, it feels like the color has just gone out of everything. I have these old watercolor books I usually like looking at, but even those just make me feel heavy instead of interested right now. So, yes, I've been feeling pretty down.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well, it's been about three months now. The low mood and that fogginess... they've been there most days. It started right around the time I began preparing to leave my job at the library.
Have you experienced any periods where your low mood was significantly worse than others over the past three months?
No, not really. It's been pretty consistent, honestly. I haven't noticed it being much worse on some days compared to others... it's just been a steady kind of low the whole time.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Well, like I mentioned with the watercolor books... I just don't care about them right now. And it's not just that. I usually enjoy reading or even just going for a walk around the neighborhood, but lately, I haven't wanted to do any of it. I just don't have the interest or the energy for the things I used to like doing.
Do you still enjoy things when you do them, even if you don't feel like doing them?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I guess... I haven't really forced myself to do any of those things lately, so I don't know if I'd enjoy them once I started or not. I just haven't had it in me to try.
Do you feel pleasure when you are actually doing the activities, even if you don't feel like starting them?
Like I said, I really haven't tried. I just... I haven't picked up a book or gone for a walk, so I can't say if I'd enjoy it or not. I just haven't done them at all.
When you do happen to start one of these activities you used to enjoy, do you feel any pleasure from it?

Doc, I... I feel like we're going in circles here. I really haven't started any of them. I just sit on the couch or stay in bed. I haven't even tried, so I really couldn't tell you if I'd get anything out of it.
When you do something you normally enjoy, do you feel any pleasure?

I don't know how else to answer that. I... I just told you, I haven't done anything I normally enjoy. I haven't tried. So I really don't know if I would feel any pleasure or not. I just don't have an answer for that.
When you do manage to start doing something you used to enjoy, even if it's just for a brief moment, do you feel any pleasure at all?

Doctor, I'm really not trying to be difficult here, but I don't have a different answer to give you. Like I've been saying, I haven't managed to start anything at all. Not even for a brief moment. So I just... I don't know. I haven't done anything to find out if I'd enjoy it or not.
Do you think you would feel pleasure if you were to engage in one of these activities you used to enjoy?

I honestly couldn't tell you. I mean, maybe? But since I haven't even had the energy or the desire to try picking up a book or doing anything else, I just don't know how I'd react. I guess I'd like to think I would enjoy it, but right now, it's hard to imagine feeling much of anything.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that would normally bring you happiness?

Look, I feel like we're just going in circles now. I... I really don't know. Like I've been saying, I haven't done anything to test that out. I guess I just feel unable to do the activities in the first place. Whether I'd feel happiness or not if I actually did them... well, I really just don't have an answer for you. That's all I can tell you.
Do you feel like there's anything that you still enjoy or look forward to?

No, not really. I mean... I don't think there's anything I'm looking forward to right now. I just sort of wake up and get through the day. There's nothing on the horizon that I'm excited about or... or that I'm eager to do. It's just kind of blank.
Do you feel like you've lost the ability to experience pleasure in general?

I'm really not sure. I mean, I don't know if the ability itself is completely gone. I just... I haven't felt much of anything lately. Like I said, it's just kind of blank right now. I couldn't tell you for sure if I've lost the capacity for it entirely, I just haven't really noticed.
Do you feel like you are unable to experience pleasure from things that would normally bring you happiness?

I think we just went over this, didn't we? Like I said a couple of minutes ago, I really don't know. I just haven't been doing the things I used to do, so I don't have a way to test it out. I can't tell you if they'd make me happy or not because I'm just not doing them. I really don't have a better answer for you on that one.
Can you think of any activities that you have done recently where you felt some kind of pleasure?

No, I can't. Like I said, I haven't really been doing much of anything lately. Just going to work at the library, coming home, and getting through the day. There hasn't been anything recently that I've done where I felt... pleasure, or anything like that. Just the same blank feeling.
Have you felt a lack of pleasure in your daily activities?

I feel like we're going in circles here. Yes, I guess you could say that. My daily activities are just... getting up, going to the library, shelving books, coming home. I don't feel pleasure doing any of that. It's just a routine I have to get through. Like I've been saying, it's all just flat. There's no joy in it, but I don't know if I'd call it a lack of pleasure specifically, it's just... nothing.
Do you feel a lack of pleasure in things that you are actually able to do?

I really don't know how else to say it. I'm just doing the basics... going to work, coming home. I don't feel much of anything while I'm doing them. It's not like I'm doing things I used to enjoy and finding them boring now. I'm just... existing, I guess. So, no, I don't feel pleasure in the things I'm doing, but I'm not really doing anything special anyway.
Do you feel a lack of pleasure in the things you are doing?
I... I feel like I've answered this three times now. Yes. I don't feel pleasure in what I'm doing. It's just work and coming home. There's no pleasure in it.
Would you say your low mood is mild, moderate, or severe?

I guess I'd say it's moderate. It's just... most days lately I sit at the kitchen table and it feels like the color has gone out of everything. Even my old watercolor books, which I used to like looking at, they just make me feel heavy now instead of interested. So yeah, moderate, I suppose.
